result.title: AYO: A Safe and Privacy-Preserving Platform for Studying Children's Interaction with LLMs
result.comment: Accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Child Safety in AI
result.summary: Children and adolescents are increasingly interacting with generative AI and large language models (LLMs), yet little is known about how these interactions may influence their development, beliefs, and behavior. Existing research has relied heavily on surveys, while direct study of children's interactions with LLMs presents substantial challenges related to safety, privacy, consent, and experimental control. We introduce AYO (AI Youth Open Science), an open-source platform designed for safe and systematic research on children's interactions with conversational AI. AYO provides a child-friendly interface, configurable age-based safety guardrails, researcher monitoring, and privacy-preserving data practices. These capabilities enable cross-sectional, longitudinal, and experimental research on how children use and respond to LLMs and how AI design may shape trust, epistemic judgment, curiosity, and other aspects of development. AYO provides the infrastructure to generate evidence that guides safer AI systems, educational practices, and policies for children growing up with AI.

AI.brief_summary: AYO 是一个面向儿童与对话式 AI 交互研究的开源平台，提供儿童友好界面、可配置的年龄分级安全护栏、研究者监控与隐私保护数据流程，以支持横断面、纵向与实验研究。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是面向人机交互与 AI 伦理的实验基础设施，虽提到「认知判断」「信任」等发展性指标，但不涉及视觉或多模态推理的内部表示、latent 状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策，缺少可迁移的方法线索。
